requirements.title: Risk-based baseline 3 is explicit, solo-agent compatible and fail-closed
requirements.rationale: New verification, agentic review, privacy and domain duties must not silently migrate projects or treat missing safeguards as satisfied.

criteria.expected: Explicit policy 3 preserves legacy semantics, requires safeguards 2 and current verification/review, and reopens changed adoption duties. Solo implementing-agent review is accepted without human sign-off; missing/inconclusive verification and plausible disclosure or limit defects cannot pass.

requirements.title: Explicit bounded equivalent source-check reuse

source.excerpt: The checkout must be the observed integrated commit

requirements.rationale: Reuse must preserve exact source, producer, input and freshness guarantees without relabelling earlier execution as post-merge or artifact qualification.

criteria.expected: Opt-in policy-3 native source-check reuse requires provider correspondence, equivalent inputs and bounded age; uncertain initial evidence uses fresh execution and later changes invalidate reuse. Contract fixtures do not establish live-provider availability or agent effectiveness.

members.assertion: Provider correspondence rejects stale, skipped, missing or different train/run/project inputs; GitHub demands the exact integrated merge-group identity.
members.discriminating_case: Other green jobs or a rewritten GitHub commit cannot substitute for native correspondence.

members.assertion: Actual Git objects must establish the exact integrated checkout and equal trees without replacement refs.
members.discriminating_case: A changed tree, different HEAD, missing object or replacement-ref alias fails.

members.assertion: The private derivation changes only native run/source/stage identity and validates all remaining current inputs against the original execution.
members.discriminating_case: Drift in commands, configuration, environment, tool bytes, producer, policy, ledger treatment or source is rejected.

members.assertion: Completion time comes from the exact supported record with bounded age.
members.discriminating_case: Expired, future, duplicate, unsupported, changed-input or mismatched records cannot qualify.

members.assertion: Unverifiable initial reuse falls back to actual fresh execution and explicitly discloses that no candidate was reused.
members.discriminating_case: A real counter observes one command execution, not zero or a hidden duplicate.

members.assertion: Schema-2 candidate production is explicit, executes once and binds current completion time; schema 1 does not silently opt in.
members.discriminating_case: A synthetic merge-group event without reviewed policy 2 cannot invoke candidate production.

members.assertion: Equivalent candidate checks cannot establish a literal post-merge MinimumCD obligation.
members.discriminating_case: A previous pass becomes unverified while known failures/errors/migration gaps remain visible.
